items.title: Christopher "Happy" Goldston Interview, 1962-04-11
items.q: They had Baby Bill and Pepe. And they played.

ctx.x: No other name. But he's a real man.

But they mostly called him Happy. And he was a brass band man. Snatch drum, he could play some snatch drum too. Well, I heard him play bass drum in church. Yeah, he could play bass drum, but he mostly played. Yeah, he played bass drum, but he mostly played. Played snatch drum. They had Baby Bill and Pepe. And they played. Yeah, he was a brass band man. He played snatch drum. He played snatch drum too. Well, I heard him play bass drum in church.
Yeah, he played bass drum, but he mostly played snatch drum. Well, then, back to all them brothers was good drummers.
